capabilities: Browse the mouse brain in a 3D whole-brain view and drill into regions
Create markdown notes attached to atlas regions, viewpoints, or cells
Search notes across all nested anatomical contexts
Cache atlas meshes and morphologies on disk for offline reuse
disambiguation: Not a mind-map diagramming tool; it is a 3D/2D brain atlas viewer where notes attach to anatomical structures.
extras: Desktop only (v1.4.0+), no mobile support; fetches data from api.brain-map.org, download.alleninstitute.org, and neuromorpho.org, with no telemetry; cache can grow to ~200 MB and is safe to delete.
motivation: The README positions it as 'The Obsidian plugin for neuroscientists working on the mouse brain', implying no such atlas-anchored note tool existed for this audience.
problem: Obsidian notes are not linked to any anatomical context, so neuroscientists cannot attach notes to specific brain regions or atlas locations.

relations.evidence: the Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (CCFv3) for regions and reference sections

summary: Visual note-taking plugin that anchors markdown notes to brain regions, 2D atlas sections, and cells in a 3D Allen Mouse Brain Atlas viewer.
